description: Find series by words in their id, title or coverage (all words must match; case and the ʻokina are ignored). Optional exact filters: geo, source, frequency. Returns up to 50 series a page, or fewer with limit (id, title, unit, frequency, geo, coverage, source). Figures are public statistics exactly as the agencies published them, with each one's period, retrieval date and source. Each result has a coverage line that says exactly what the figure covers (for example, I-94 arrivals are U.S.-wide by country of residence, not arrivals to Hawaiʻi). Each result carries the notice its source requires, and our Terms ask that it stay with the figure. Facts, not investment or other advice.

frequency.description: D daily, W weekly, M monthly, Q quarterly, A annual

geo.description: Geography code, e.g. HI, HI.HON, HI.HAW, HI.MAU, HI.KAU, HI.KAL, US

page.description: Page number (limit series a page); default 1

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "unemployment rate Kauai"

source.description: Source id from list_sources, e.g. BLS, BTS, CENSUSTRADE

name: search_series
title: Search the series catalog
